offers_products.reason: Sells vacation ownership interests (timeshare points, fractional and whole ownership) in Marriott Vacation Club, Sheraton, Westin, Ritz-Carlton Club resorts.

offers_services.reason: Resort management, rentals, exchange services (Interval International), financing of owners' purchases, and hospitality experiences for owners and guests.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Owners and their families buy vacation ownership; guests book nightly rentals and vacations.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual owners, members and vacationing guests; no meaningful business or government buyers named.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largest part is new timeshare sales and financing; management fees recur, but sales of ownership interests are the biggest share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Vacation ownership purchases are discretionary leisure spending that households can postpone in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Timeshare ownership interests are costly, infrequent purchases for households, typically financed by loans.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for ownership interests in resort properties and points programs, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual households buying vacation ownership, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Develops and operates 60+ resorts with thousands of villas, plus inventory and a financing portfolio, needing ongoing property investment.

notes: Business split is based on general knowledge of timeshare sales dominating revenue; the website text does not show proportions.
